name: Imprimerie Chaix
summary: A Paris printing works that Napoléon Chaix founded. From 1881 it printed the colour posters of Jules Chéret, its artistic director. It merged with Desfossé-Néogravure in 1965, and the Saint-Ouen works were sold in 1981.
